rule: ไฟ files by WHO LIT IT. Sense 1 is the element, so it takes fire that no one started and no one owns — ไฟป่า arises by itself, ภูเขาไฟ comes out of the earth, ไฟกัลป์ ends the world. Sense 2 is combustion you make and feed, and it takes the largest share: everything lit, fuelled, cooked on, or burned by, plus the two things named for looking like flame (หมากไฟ) or burning like it (โซดาไฟ, calqued on caustic soda). Sense 3 is electricity. The RID gives ไฟ no sense for 'a lamp' at all, so the lamps have to split by their fuel — a flame lamp (คบไฟ, เรือนไฟ, กระโจมไฟ, ช่องไฟ the wall-niche you set one in) files at 2, an electric one (ไฟหน้า, ไฟท้าย, and the whole traffic set ไฟแดง / ไฟเหลือง / ไฟเขียว / ไฟจราจร / สัญญาณไฟ) at 3. That is a line the words themselves do not draw, and a lighthouse has crossed it since the compound was made. Sense 4 (ความเดือดร้อน) takes only the figurative ไฟไหม้, 'most urgent' — not a house alight.

notes.h2: 2026-09-02 — heads 95-99, and a head that would not file
notes.text:
**ไฟ files by WHO LIT IT, and that is the whole rule.** Sense 1 is the element,
so it takes fire nobody started — ไฟป่า arises by itself, ภูเขาไฟ comes out of the
earth, ไฟกัลป์ ends the world. Sense 2 is combustion you make and feed, and takes
19 of 31. **But the RID gives ไฟ no sense for 'a lamp' at all**, so the lamps have
to split by their FUEL: a flame lamp (คบไฟ, เรือนไฟ, ช่องไฟ the wall-niche you set
one in, กระโจมไฟ a lighthouse) at 2, an electric one (ไฟหน้า, ไฟท้าย, and the
traffic set) at 3. That line is not in the words. A lighthouse has crossed it
since the compound was made, and the entry cannot show that.
